conbody.p: To activate the one-touch lane change function, move the turn signal lever slightly and then release it. The turn signals will blink 3, 5, or 7 times depending on the setting.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsOne Touch Turn signal on the infotainment system to activate or deactivate the one-touch lane change function, or to select the number of flashes (3, 5, or 7).

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more information, refer to the manual provided in the infotainment system and the quick reference guide.
If the turn signal indicator stays on without flashing or flashes abnormally, one of the turn signal lamps may be malfunctioning and should be inspected and replaced as necessary.
